8,196 reviews. 4.6 stars. And most tourists book somewhere else.

Sol by Meliá Phu Quoc sits right on Đường Bào with beach views, 3 restaurants, 2 bars, and a pool that actually gets quiet mid-morning. Rooms are bright, suites are legit, and the whole property runs smooth.

If your Phu Quoc trip needs a solid base that won't disappoint, this one delivers. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
